rules: Concepts and genres can be the same historical concept across the two graphs, but must not be used as automatic BFS bridges between arbitrary people or works.
Chapters are separate editorial resources, never traversable historical nodes.
Do not conflate opera buffa with dramma giocoso, or string quartet genre with arbitrary quartets.
